enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Deception +6: +6 Insight bonus to hit and +9 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +22 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.

Nearly Complete: Insightful Ability Score: This item isn't quite finished, but it's only a step away from completion. Bring it to the forges on the upper floor of Gravenhollow and combine it with melted materials to restore this item to its full potential.

children.text: This item can be upgraded with one of the following:

children.tooltip: Insightful Charisma +7: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +7 Insight bonus to Charisma.
Insightful Constitution +7: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +7 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Insightful Dexterity +7: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +7 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Intelligence +7: This item focuses the power of the wearer's mind, granting a +7 Insight bonus to Intelligence.
Insightful Strength +7: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +7 Insight bonus to Strength.
Insightful Wisdom +7: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +7 Insight bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
